derived_full_intended_bounds.interpretation: Sensitivity bounds only, distinct from uncertainty intervals and conditional accuracy; an unavailable answer could have been correct or incorrect.

limitations: Post-hoc pooled evaluation requested after observing both acquisition waves; not a new frozen primary or one physical execution.
Complete-core selection is based on usable output, not correctness; full intended missingness and frozen original primary remain in source analyses.
Acquisition-wave and renderer differences are preserved in provenance; this estimate describes the pooled finite controlled suite, not population or model drift.
Old families have no comparable explicit new topic/operation metadata and remain individual clusters in sensitivity analyses; crossed template dependence is not fully identified.

The diagnostic component panel includes all 32 old families and 101 new families: 24.06% old in the panel versus 4.83% old in the joint core; pooled CFR is conditional on that panel, not representative of all 662 families.
All intervals are descriptive, unadjusted for multiplicity; zero independent human reviews. Missing components remain unavailable, never NO.
release_scope: Scientific results accompanying the public GoldfishBench dataset and offline evaluator. Original metric objects are unchanged. Private raw provider archives, account/billing records and unrelated projects are excluded.

public_release.arxiv_status: No public arXiv identifier assigned; author reports endorsement pending.
